verdict.rationale: Ashby's first-party Slack integration lets users "approve offers", which implies some offer-approval capability exists within the product. Nothing documents approval of job openings or postings, configurable multi-step approval chains, or gating that keeps items from going live or being sent until approved. missing for 10: job opening/posting approval workflows, configurable approval chain definitions (approvers, steps, conditions), evidence that offers are blocked from sending until approved, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, job openings and offers route through configurable approval chains before anything goes live or gets sent

citations.quote: Get instant alerts, approve offers, and automatically create channels for interviews with Ashby's Slack integration.
